exposure: Health insurance coverage scheme (contributory, government subsidised, uninsured)
cohort: The study included all live births (2,506,920) and neonatal deaths (17,712) in Colombia between 2008 and 2011.
finding: Health insurance through the contributory system is associated with lower neonatal mortality compared to insurance through the subsidised system or lack of insurance.
mod_finding: There was a higher fraction of C-section deliveries among women in the contributory scheme, and controlling for C-section delivery increased the observed differences in NMR between insurance schemes.
